queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR GPT OR "generative model") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "router configuration" OR "intent to configuration" OR "network change" OR "configuration synthesis")
queries.rationale: Locate work where LLMs or generative models are used to produce network configurations, change plans, or intent->configuration translations (core phenomenon).
source_preferences: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management

queries.query: (hallucinat* OR "incorrect" OR "misconfig*" OR "unsafe" OR failure OR error) AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR GPT) AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR BGP OR ACL OR SDN)
queries.rationale: Identify empirical and conceptual studies of LLM failure modes specific to networking outputs (hallucinations, incorrect configs, dangerous suggestions).

queries.query: "network verification" OR "formal verification" OR "header space analysis" OR Batfish OR VeriFlow OR Anteater OR NetPlumber OR "config verification"
queries.rationale: Gather established formal/deterministic verifiers and analysis tools for network configurations to serve as validators or benchmarks for LLM outputs (mechanisms for checking correctness).

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-validate" OR "LLM+verifier" OR "tool-assisted" OR "toolformer" OR "self-correction" OR "refinement loop") AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Find architectures that pair generation with validators/repair loops (LLM-driven generation plus deterministic checks and automated repair), relevant mitigations and system designs.

queries.query: ("constrained decoding" OR "constrained generation" OR "controlled generation" OR "structured generation" OR "schema-guided generation") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (configuration OR NetOps OR "structured output")
queries.rationale: Search for techniques to force structured, constraint-respecting outputs (e.g., grammars, templates, constrained decoding) applicable to network configuration generation.

queries.query: ("NetOps benchmark" OR "AIOps benchmark" OR "network benchmark" OR "configuration benchmark" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR OpsEval OR OWL OR "NetBench")
queries.rationale: Locate existing datasets and benchmarks aimed at NetOps/AIOps to evaluate construct validity and identify gaps (benchmark validity and coverage).
source_preferences: dataset pages and Zenodo / GitHub releases

queries.query: ("evaluation metric" OR "construct validity" OR "task validity" OR "benchmark validity" OR "operational validity") AND (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps OR "LLM evaluation")
queries.rationale: Find literature on what evaluation metrics actually measure in NetOps/LLM contexts and methods for validating that benchmarks reflect operational concerns.

queries.query: (Mininet OR "ns-3" OR GNS3 OR "emulation" OR "network simulator") AND ("configuration testing" OR "validation" OR "execution environment" OR "NetOps testing")
queries.rationale: Identify simulation and emulation platforms suitable for executing or validating generated configurations (important for operational realism and external validity).

queries.query: (adversarial OR attack OR "prompt injection" OR "data poisoning" OR robustness) AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Survey adversarial/robustness work relevant to poisoning, prompt attacks, or adversarial inputs that could cause unsafe NetOps outputs (threat mechanisms).
source_preferences: industrial security reports with verifiable metadata

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" OR "assisted automation") AND (NetOps OR network OR "LLM" OR "automation")
queries.rationale: Find interaction models that balance automation and human oversight—designs for operational safeguards and deployment mitigations.
source_preferences: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management

queries.query: ("program synthesis" OR "code LLM" OR Copilot OR "LLM for code" OR "configuration management" OR Ansible OR Terraform) AND (automation OR "infrastructure as code" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Explore adjacent literatures (program synthesis, IaC) where LLMs generate structured artifacts and where safety/validation techniques may transfer to NetOps.

queries.query: (reproducibility OR "pre-registration" OR disclosure OR "AI-generated" OR "autonomous researcher" OR "agentic AI") AND (publication OR experiment OR NotebookLM OR "methodology")
queries.rationale: Collect best practices and standards for reproducible, disclosed autonomous-AI research outputs (relevant to the CNSM track constraints).

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed publications or arXiv/preprints with verifiable metadata (title, authors, year, venue/identifier).
Works that address LLM/generative-model outputs applied to NetOps, network configuration, change planning, or related automation.
Tool papers and project pages for verifiers, simulators, and benchmarks with accessible artifacts (code, dataset, or demo).
Papers on validation/verification, mitigation architectures (generate-validate-repair, constrained generation), evaluation methodology, and human-in-the-loop designs relevant to operational NetOps.
Security/robustness studies (adversarial attacks, prompt injection) that have concrete implications for NetOps safety.
Related literatures (program synthesis, IaC, DevOps automation) when they provide transferable methods or evaluation insights.
exclusion_criteria: Non-verifiable marketing materials, vendor blogs, or press releases without supporting technical artifacts or identifiable authorship.
Works purely about unrelated application domains (e.g., vision-only LLMs) unless they provide generalizable methods for structured-output safety.
Informal forum posts or Q&A threads lacking citable metadata.
Papers prior to ~2010 except when clearly foundational for network verification (e.g., seminal header-space analysis) — include only when directly relevant.
date_rationale: Emphasize recent work from ~2020–2026 because the LLM era and agentic systems matured in this window; include 2010–2019 selectively for foundational network-verification and formal-methods works (e.g., header-space analysis, NetPlumber) that underpin validators used in mitigation architectures.
